title: Perfect LOCATION! Walk to Downtown & Restaurants
description:
Super quick Uber ride to Downtown. Walk to baseball games, farmers' market, and amazing restaurants all around you. This peaceful 4-bedroom/3-full-bath home will feel like a home away from home in the heart of Nashville's best neighborhood, Germantown. Parking enough for 4 cars. Backyard with a deck.

The space
One bedroom and full bath downstairs with open kitchen and living room and large dining table. Upstairs you will find three bedrooms, 2 king and one queen. Two bedrooms share a Jack & Jill bathroom and the master is gigantic with an amazing, spa like bath and private balcony. The back yard is large with a very nice deck with gas grill and enough space to have a great back yard BBQ. Finally, if you are diving in locally, you have plenty of room to park 4+ cars.

Guest access
Entire house and property
